Definition: to hang up, i.e. weigh, or (figuratively) contemn
BiblicalUsage: 1) to make light of, toss aside; 1a) (Qal) to make light of; 1b) (Piel) to flout, reject; 2) to weigh, balance; 2a) (Pual) to be weighed
